name: VU Thrive Grant
summary: Grant for current VU students struggling with study costs such as books, equipment or travel, sized to your evidence.
who: Current onshore VU student in a higher education or TAFE course with at least 48 credit points or 270 hours.
Experiencing financial hardship related to study expenses (not tuition or SSAF).
Not already received the grant this academic year.
how: Apply through VU's application portal with bank statements, invoices or quotes.
catches: The amount depends on the evidence you provide.
Not available for the same period if you got a Commonwealth Prac Payment in the past 12 months.

evidence.quote: experiencing financial hardship related to your study expenses
The value of the grant will be determined based on the evidence provided in your application.
